Since 2019, The Rubin Commercial Group has operated as a boutique commercial real estate firm specializing in distinctive and often overlooked opportunities.

Founded by Josh Rubin, Esq., the firm brings a hands-on, strategic approach to sourcing, structuring, and executing transactions. RCG’s assignments span traditional commercial real estate as well as operating businesses and specialty assets, including office condominium portfolios, summer camps, RV resorts, and marinas. Value-add assignments have ranged from repurposed college campuses to large-acreage industrial sites, along with equity raises and other capital needs for sponsors.

Backed by a trusted national network of brokers, owners, and industry professionals, The Rubin Commercial Group identifies opportunities beyond the traditional market and brings them to fruition through relationships, strategic thinking, and disciplined execution.

WHY RCG

Our approach is start‑to‑finish.

LISTEN

We listen to our clients to understand their investment goals, operational needs, risk tolerance, and long-term strategy.

SOURCE

We leverage an active network of owners, investors, lenders, and industry professionals to source opportunities that align with our clients’ specific needs and objectives.

STRUCTURE

Beyond identifying opportunities, we take an active role in structuring transactions, aligning interests, resolving challenges, and bringing the right parties together to move deals toward closing. When financing, equity, or additional deal structure is required, we help connect clients with the right capital partners and work to create solutions that move transactions forward.

DELIVER

We believe deeply in relationships. Our goal is to deliver for clients again and again, building long-term partnerships, not one-time transactions.
